chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"If a man proposes to a woman and consummates the marriage with her before she reaches nine years of age, they are separated and she is not permissible to him forever."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man consummates marriage with a girl under the age of nine?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the permanent prohibition (haram li-dawam) of a husband to his wife if consummation occurs before she reaches the age of nine, distinguishing it from temporary or revocable divorces. It reflects the classical Shia juristic consensus on the minimum age of puberty (bulugh) for valid marital consummation, serving as a foundational text for family law in Shia fiqh.
